hook_text: 3/4 + 2/3 is NOT 5/7. Here is why, in one cup of flour.
clip_script: Three quarters plus two thirds: four and three have LCM twelve. Three quarters is nine twelfths; two thirds is eight twelfths. Nine twelfths plus eight twelfths is seventeen twelfths, which is one and five twelfths. The most common error is to add the denominators as well: three quarters plus two thirds is NOT five sevenths. Five sevenths is less than one, but three quarters plus two thirds is clearly more than one.
visual_style: Two measuring cups, three quarters and two thirds full, poured into a cup marked in twelfths that overflows into a second cup.
pacing: Fast wrong answer, pause, pour and count twelfths, reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master borrowing when you subtract mixed numbers.
